scripts.dev: concurrently -r "bun run css:watch" "bun run client:watch" "bun --watch src/server-main.ts"
scripts.assets:build: bun run client:build && bun run css:build
scripts.client:build: bun -e 'await (await import("node:fs/promises")).rm("static/build", { recursive: true, force: true })' && bun build static/app/main.js --outdir static/build --target browser --format esm --splitting --entry-naming '[name].js' --chunk-naming 'chunks/[name]-[hash].js' --asset-naming 'assets/[name]-[hash].[ext]' --define process.env.NODE_ENV="production" --ignore-dce-annotations --minify && bun build src/client/pierre-worker.ts --outfile static/build/pierre-worker.js --target browser --format esm --define process.env.NODE_ENV="production" --ignore-dce-annotations --minify
scripts.client:watch: bun -e 'await (await import("node:fs/promises")).rm("static/build", { recursive: true, force: true })' && bun build src/client/pierre-worker.ts --outfile static/build/pierre-worker.js --target browser --format esm --define process.env.NODE_ENV="development" --ignore-dce-annotations --sourcemap=inline && bun build static/app/main.js --outdir static/build --target browser --format esm --splitting --entry-naming '[name].js' --chunk-naming 'chunks/[name]-[hash].js' --asset-naming 'assets/[name]-[hash].[ext]' --define process.env.NODE_ENV="development" --ignore-dce-annotations --sourcemap=inline --watch --no-clear-screen
scripts.css:build: bun scripts/generate-basecoat-css.ts && bunx tailwindcss -i src/ui/styles.css -o static/app.css --minify
scripts.css:watch: bun scripts/generate-basecoat-css.ts && bunx tailwindcss -i src/ui/styles.css -o static/app.css --watch --silent
